title: The census.phase docs name every command that writes the row, and the digest reads detect's exit 1 as no failure
goal: kb/_self/querylog.md's census.phase sentence names every command of census.PHASES (repin, judge and dispatch among them); ql_report.py's ops block counts a census.phase row of factdiff.py detect that exited 1 (facts to review) as no failure

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census, re
t = open('kb/_self/querylog.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
i = t.index('`census.phase` (`phase`')
s = t[i:t.index('none for a `--dry-run`', i)]
miss = [k for k in census.PHASES if not re.search(r'(?<![\w-])%s(?![\w-])' % k, s)]
print('the census.phase sentence lacks', miss)
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

import json, re, sys, tempfile, uuid
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import ql_report
run = '20261021T000000Z-0000abcd'
rows = [{'id': str(uuid.uuid4()), 'ts': '2026-10-21T00:00:01.000Z', 'event': 'census.phase', 'phase': 'detect', 'date': '2026-10-21', 'ms': 5, 'exit': 1},
        {'id': str(uuid.uuid4()), 'ts': '2026-10-21T00:00:02.000Z', 'event': 'census.phase', 'phase': 'check', 'date': '2026-10-21', 'ms': 7, 'exit': 0}]
f = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / (run + '.jsonl')
f.write_text('\n'.join(json.dumps(o, separators=(',', ':')) for o in [{'run': run, 'counts': {'rows': len(rows)}}, *rows]) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
line = [l for l in ql_report.ops_lines([f], lambda d: True) if l.strip().startswith('census.phase')]
print(line)
sys.exit(0 if line and re.search(r'failed 0\b', line[0]) else 1)
